violated_contract: A wire-flash firmware artifact must not replace a hardware-qualified bootloader with an unqualified default implementation, even when the application and its OTA package are valid.
canonical_prevention: Build the board-specific bootloader entrypoint explicitly, verify its key and layout, and parse every staged wire image against a pinned padded boot-region hash at staging and publication. Emit app-only recovery images while replacement bootloaders await physical qualification.
